svg.title: About Mobina Haghshenas
svg.desc: Industrial Engineering graduate interested in data analytics, machine learning, mathematical optimization, simulation, explainable AI, healthcare, and medical imaging.
svg.text: I’m an Industrial Engineering graduate interested in using data and analytical methods to support better decisions.
My work and learning focus on data analytics, machine learning, mathematical optimization, and simulation—from
exploring patterns in datasets to modeling real-world systems and comparing possible solutions.
I’m particularly interested in explainable AI and the use of deep learning in healthcare and medical imaging.
I value clear problem formulation, thoughtful method selection, and communicating what an analysis can—and
